710-728-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-728-8207.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

141-1854-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-2921.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-728-1879.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-5332.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

851-1308-2557-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-1308-2557-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2034-4068-6970-7763-7850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2034-4068-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

3532-5078-5901-7811.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3532-5078-5901-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

5733-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
5733-7443.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance and a Rogue as an attacker, triggering Emeritus of Abundance's ability, causing it to become prepared.
Deal combat damage using the Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
5733-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

856-2438-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

465-2150-3967.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

3473-6901.description: Whenever you lose life, Transcendence's second ability triggers, causing you to gain no life due to Sunspine Lynx.

2957-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
2957-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1789-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
413-1789-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Blasting Station trigger.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-2770-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
413-2770-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

3011-4174.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-4174.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage equal to half your life total rounded down to you.

1350-1887-4554.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {4}{W}{U}, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Teferi from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2038-2557-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1750-2793-2829-5261-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-2829-5261-5740.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

262-3713-4321.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Steelfin Whale.
Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness and has a power of 1 or greater.
262-3713-4321.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1218-5076-5280.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Kederekt Parasite +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

852-2615-4498.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal and Tree of Perdition do not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at lest two.
852-2615-4498.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing Tree of Perdition to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The opponent targeted in step 2 loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns if your life total allows.

579-2438-2661-4484.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
579-2438-2661-4484.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {2}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

1703-2034-3483-3783.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cromat, adding {C}{C}.
Cromat dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Cromat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Cromat.
Repeat.

156-1642.notablePrerequisites:
Warlock Class is level three.
Your life total is at least 2.
156-1642.description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves with kicker by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Scourge of the Skyclaves enters the battlefield, causing each player to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1987-3016-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
1987-3016-4423.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary and any other land, blinking them.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to top of your library.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from top of your library by paying {2}{U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary and any other land.
Melek triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker, targeting any two other lands, blinking them.
Resolve the Ghostly Flicker, blinking them.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and three other lands, adding mana of any color that land can produce.
Repeat from step 3.
